item.title: Behind the Bylines: Not a joke, but we’re the punchline
item.description: There are times when it’s important to take comedy seriously. This is one of those times. Recently, Stephen Colbert recorded an interview with Texas Senate candidate James Talarico, then told viewers that CBS lawyers would not allow the segment to air on broadcast television. Colbert said that CBS would not let him air his interview because of FCC equal-time concerns.
